text:
kevin_sales: Tideway demo tomorrow AM. They're hitting high first-token latency (p95 ~5s) and intermittent 429s during our prefill stage. Load generator spikes to ~130rps for ~60s. Need quick triage and a mitigation plan, cc @nina_eng @omar_infra

nina_eng: Confirm hosted route and model, and whether session_id is stable or random per user? Also paste any short logs you have.

kevin_sales: Hosted route default-prod/tideway, model rw-13b-v2-int8. session_id=random per user, prefill=true, max_tokens=512. Log snippet: 

```
[2026-03-24T10:02:11Z] shard=9 batcher: queued=20
[2026-03-24T10:02:11Z] batcher: emitted batch_size=1 (queue_time=220ms)
[2026-03-24T10:02:12Z] kv_cache: miss key=session_7f3
[2026-03-24T10:02:13Z] handler: first_token_time=2.3s
[2026-03-24T10:02:13Z] limiter: reject=circuit_breaker -> 429
```

omar_infra: Quick analysis: tiny batches (batch_size p50=2) + high queue_time -> inefficient inference starts; high KV miss due to random session ids; circuit breaker tripping from shard overload. Metrics requested: batch_size hist, queue_time p95, kv_hit_rate, shard_cpu.

kevin_sales: Metrics for spike window: batch_size p50=2 p95=9, queue_time p95=210ms, kv_hit_rate=20%, shard_cpu=88%, rejects=38.

nina_eng: Short-term mitigations: (1) throttle client ramp to ~30-40rps for demo, (2) canary route change: batch_window_ms=60, min_batch_size=6, enable session_pooling on server to reuse KV entries, (3) ask client to reuse session_ids for warmup to improve cache.

omar_infra: I'll start a canary with those settings and add a small backoff on prefill path to smooth bursts.

ops_bot: Canary deploy started: default-prod/tideway config batch_window_ms=60 min_batch_size=6 session_pooling=true backoff=exp50ms job=f1a2.

nina_eng: Canary 5m results: batch_size p50->6 p95->11, queue_time p95->90ms, kv_hit_rate->39%, first-token p95 improved 5.0s->1.6s, 429s dropped to 0 in window.

omar_infra: Good. Long-term recommendations: add a persistent warmup pool that opens sessions to populate KV, consider route prefill_concurrency_limit, and offer a temporary shard scale-up for large demos.

lina_privacy: Security note: customer asked about prefill data retention. Hosted logs default to 7d; we can opt to suppress request bodies for this account or enable PII redaction. Kevin, collect their questionnaire and I'll respond.

kevin_sales: Will send the questionnaire and tell Tideway to throttle ramp and run a 2-minute warmup reusing session_ids. Thanks team! :tada:
